model_settings.value: Parallel independent component analysis with multiple references (pICA-MR) decomposed fMRI and SNP data into components in parallel. Fifteen fMRI components were estimated by minimum description length and 11 SNP components by component consistency. Genetic references constrained components using Euclidean-distance minimization, with adaptively adjusted constraint weighting; intermodality correlations were optimized only above a threshold of 0.25. Ten-fold validation and 1,000-run permutation testing were performed.

estimator.value: Iterative gradient optimization of the unmixing matrices using infomax-based pICA-MR.

spans.text: The collected fMRI data were preprocessed with Statistical Parametric Mapping 5 (SPM5, http://www.fil.ion.ucl.ac.uk/spm ). Standard motion correction was performed and images were normalized to the Montreal Neurological Institute template [Jenkinson et al., 2002 ] and resliced to 3 × 3 × 3 mm 3 . An 8‐mm full‐width half‐maximum Gaussian kernel was used for spatial smoothing. Finally, alcohol versus juice contrast images were extracted from a total of 54,937 voxels with no missing values and used for subsequent association analyses.
